name: tares
description: Open-source platform for always-on AI agents: a software factory for Claude Code that takes your projects from tickets to merged pull requests, or an AI SRE that watches your systems. The plugin connects Claude Code to Tares over MCP, streams sessions in, specs projects with /tares:spec, and runs the tares-factory crew and challenger sessions.

tares_url.title: Tares URL
tares_url.description: Base URL of your Tares (default http://127.0.0.1:8787 for a local tares up; your cell URL on Tares Cloud, e.g. https://<cell>.tares-glassflow.com).

mcp_url.title: MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Where Claude reaches Tares's MCP server. Local: run tares mcp --transport streamable-http next to tares up and keep the default. Tares Cloud: https://<cell>.tares-glassflow.com/mcp.

access_token.title: API key / token (optional)
access_token.description: Leave empty on an open local instance. On a secured instance or Tares Cloud, an admin API key from Security > API keys: /tares:spec creates projects and writes their docs and tickets, which needs admin. A read + ingest key is enough if you only stream sessions and read.

stream_sessions.title: Stream this session into Tares
stream_sessions.description: true or false; empty = true. When on, this session's transcript is shipped to Tares's claude_code source as it progresses.

challenger_mode.title: Challenger mode for commits
challenger_mode.description: strict or advise; empty = strict. strict: P1/P2 findings from the second model on a commit block Claude until fixed and amended. advise: findings come back as context only. Only matters in a challenger session.

challenger_backend.title: Challenger model
challenger_backend.description: codex or grok; empty = codex. codex: the Codex CLI on this laptop reviews. grok: Grok reviews over the xAI API, billed to your xAI account; needs the xAI API key below.

xai_api_key.title: xAI API key (optional)
xai_api_key.description: Only for challenger_backend grok. Empty = the XAI_API_KEY environment variable.

grok_model.title: Grok model (optional)
grok_model.description: Only for challenger_backend grok. Empty = grok-4.6. Use a reasoning model: non-reasoning ones invent findings.

codex_bin.title: Codex CLI path (optional)
codex_bin.description: Empty = codex on PATH. Full path to the Codex CLI otherwise.

codex_sandbox.title: Codex sandbox (optional)
codex_sandbox.description: Empty = Codex's read-only sandbox (enough for reviews). workspace-write or danger-full-access when Codex needs to run the project's commands.
